summary: Sanitize Cobra positional labels before using them as MCP input-schema property names: interpret '|' as 'Or', remove leading '@' display syntax, replace remaining unsupported characters, and cap keys at 64 characters.
reason: The deployed youtube-pp-mcp exposed six Anthropic-invalid property keys: '@handle|channelId' on youtube_channel_uploads and 'videoId|url' on five video tools. Anthropic rejects the entire request with HTTP 400 because tool property keys must match ^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,64}$. Preserve the human-facing Cobra Use labels while emitting legal structured MCP keys such as handleOrChannelId and videoIdOrUrl.
validated_outcome: Built from the deployed binary's matching schema-9 source. go test ./... and go vet ./... pass. tools/list exposes 39 tools with zero invalid property keys; youtube_channel_uploads uses handleOrChannelId and the five affected video tools use videoIdOrUrl. The rebuilt CLI reads the existing schema-version-9 database successfully.
